proxy.definition: share of active facts whose entity names OR 12-char text shingles overlap a managed kb document (source inferable)

instrumentation.where: admin.stats payload (the panel's polling shape), no new tool
secondary: mirror_source is set / total (the existing precedent, measured here)
instrumentation.acceptance_threshold: >= 0.30 of active facts carrying source_ref within 2 weeks of the write-side parameter shipping; below that the field is the next mirror_source (a column that exists and is always empty) and should be dropped rather than kept
instrumentation.why_offline_cannot_decide: no session traffic is available offline: whether a caller passes source_ref is a write-side behaviour, and the managed kb corpus here is empty, so even the overlap upper bound is 0 by construction

identity.note: this card counts coverage; it runs no retrieval pass, so there is no production arm to identity-check

verdict.reason: the managed kb corpus is empty and there is no session traffic, so neither the overlap upper bound nor the behavioural question can be measured offline
